Blocks.Text: The Recommended Matches certification validates that your CRM Connect integration properly handles LinkedIn's AI-powered candidate recommendations. This certification ensures your system can receive, process, and display recommended candidates effectively.

Complete the core CRM Connect certification.
Have a working CRM Connect integration with:

Candidate sync functionality
Pipeline sync functionality
Retrieve exported candidates capability


Enable Recommended Matches feature flag for your integration.
Complete the following test cases to validate your Recommended Matches integration with CRM Connect.

Rows.Text: Confirm the Recommended Matches widget loads after activating a CRM Connect integration. Recommended candidates might take 24 hours to appear after account activation and data sync completion, but the widget should load without errors.
Verify the Recommended Matches widget appears and shows recommendations related to the pipeline.
Load the recommended matches widget while logged out from LinkedIn, then log in.
Confirm the widget shows a login or signup option when logged out and displays full recommended matches profiles when logged in.
View one candidate's complete profile in the widget from the recommended matches.
Verify the full profile width displays on the specific pipeline and shows "Save to pipeline" and "Save and InMail" options.
Select one candidate from the recommended matches widget and choose "Save to pipeline".

Confirm the candidate exports to the ATS under the selected pipeline. Create a new record for new candidates or update existing records when applicable. LinkedIn Recruiter should display "Exported successfully" under the candidate.
Select "Save and InMail" for one candidate from the recommended matches widget.
Verify the "Compose Message" pane displays fully when expanded.
